crossRefs.note: Now let a little water be fetched, wash your feet, and rest yourselves under the tree.
Yet there is both straw and feed for our donkeys; and there is bread and wine also for me, and for your servant, and…
But the noble devises noble things; and he will continue in noble things.
Be hospitable to one another without grumbling.

translations.web: She said moreover to him, “We have both straw and feed enough, and room to lodge in.”
translations.bsb: Then she added, “We have plenty of straw and feed, as well as a place for you to spend the night.”
translations.kjv: She said moreover unto him, We have both straw and provender enough, and room to lodge in.
translations.asv: She said moreover unto him, We have both straw and provender enough, and room to lodge in.
